name: Gourmet Supremos: Within Our Duties
description: You bump into a group of familiar faces in Sumeru...

steps.description: Go to the Akademiya with Parvaneh and the rest of the group
Go to the headquarters of the Corps of Thirty
Taste the local specialties in Sumeru
Defeat all monsters to get materials
Give the three servings of Fresh Fish to Parvaneh
Give the two Potatoes to Parvaneh
Give the three Padisarahs to Parvaneh

dialogs.content: Ah, so this is Sumeru...
What are you sniffing?
Didn't you say Sumeru has a lot of spices? I don't smell any of them!
Spices are sealed in the warehouses. How can we even smell them at the harbor?
Whoa... That's a huge one... Is that the Divine Tree that holds the Akademiya?
Does it bear any fruit? Hmm... maybe... Divine Fruit?
There's no such fruit.
If researchers feel hungry when reading, they could pick some of these fruits to eat...
We have canteens...
Hehe, everyone, there's no point staying at the port.
Doesn't Ms. Parvaneh have some business at the Akademiya? We should head off now. Can't afford to waste time.
You came to Sumeru too?
Traveler, I didn't expect to meet you here!
It's been a while. Are you here to look for ingredients for some tasty food?
Sort of... But before we start to look for any, we need to run some errands with Parvaneh.
Actually, it's my paper on "Omni-Spice." I've finished it and am about to report to the Akademiya.
But you guys don't have to come with me! I'll catch up with you after this is over.
A bunch of people just flooding into the Akademiya... They would've thought I was hijacked!
Are you feeling embarrassed now?
Huh!? Why would I feel embarrassed!?
There's nothing fun in the Akademiya. All you can do is wait for me there...
That's all right. I've always wanted to go to the Akademiya, but I've only heard about it from people in the guild...
Ms. Parvaneh, Mr. Xudong was just worried that you could run into something sticky.
After all, you have been away for too long. No one knows what would happen on your return.
Mr. Kamei gets me!
What are you even talking about? My tutor is too nice to make things difficult for me.
I've been in contact with her. She's read my draft.
I'll just have to submit the finalized version this time.
That'd be great. You could just take us as tourists.
Going to the Akademiya for a tour... Seriously?
Come if you want. I should be able to get it over with in no time.
And after this...
I'll take you for tasty food... Don't worry I won't forget.
Yay!
Traveler, you should come with us. You offered us so much help, now it's my turn to treat you in Sumeru.
Time to dig in.
Then let's get going. It should take a while to get to the Akademiya from here.
Hehe, free meals.
Hey! That sounds weird!
I'm here for the free meals!
Wow, such a huge tree!
Watch your step when you walk. Don't fixate on that tree, Ms. Julie.
Ah! I smell it! The aroma of delicacies!
Just go and play somewhere, and I'll catch up with you in a minute...
No way. We must make sure everyone enjoys the savory meals. No one should be left out.
You are unbelievable... Fine, the Akademiya is up there. Let's get going.
Haha, Parvaneh, you are back. I've been waiting for so long.
Sorry I'm late, Ms. Farzah. Something happened on the way and it took me a while.
No worries! Your paper is well-written, and your research looks very promising, too! I've heard a lot of good words about it.
Thank you. I brought the whole paper with me...
Well... great work, Parvaneh.
I'll take a good look at it later. With your academic ability, I'm sure there won't be any issue.
Y—You are too kind, Ms. Farzah...
Did Parvaneh just blush? You don't see that every day.
It is really something to be proud of to be recognized by your mentor.
Hmm... What's going on?
What is it?
I don't like that mentor of hers...
And why is that, Ms. Julie?
Don't know. It's just a feeling...
Maybe I'm too exhausted. Don't tell Parvaneh. I don't wanna upset her.
What are you guys talking about?
Urgh... It's nothing! I—I'm starving...!
Haven't you eaten already? You really have a voracious appetite, don't you?
Ms. Julie is not a sedentary person. Of course she gets hungry fast.
Parvaneh, have you gotten it over with your business?
Almost. I'll just have to wait for the paper to be formally reviewed, which should be completed in the next few days.
After this... Hmph, I can work on the projects that I like.
The "Omni-Spice" has not been refined. I shall perfect it when I have a whole team!
I still have things to do before my paper gets approved. You better stay at Sumeru City.
I can't afford more time to look for you...
No worries. The whole city is enough for a tour.
Now that you're done here, how about you show us around?
And.. some Sumeru local specialties maybe?
Finally, huh? I can see that look on your face...
Let me see... Let's go to the headquarters of the Corps of Thirty.
Eh? Thirty people? That can't be all they have.
It's just a name, don't worry... Anyway, let's go and take a look.
Julie, why are you silent? Something wrong?
Huh? No, no. I—I'm just hungry! I'll be fine with some food.
How do you even manage to stay in shape with that appetite...
This is the place!
Stationed here is the Corps of Thirty, responsible for the defense of Sumeru City.
The name came from its founders. There were exactly thirty of them.
The entire Corps has expanded, but the name remains in memory of the founders.
Like The Four Winds in Mondstadt. Pretty easy to understand.
It's just like the Liyue Qixing in Liyue...
Eh? Why are you all looking at me?
Hmm... We have the Tri-Commission in Inazuma.
Regions have their names in a similar way.
It appears so, but it's more than thirty people when we talk about the Corps of Thirty in Sumeru.
That guard there looks like a Martial Artist. He looks really worried.
Is anyone in trouble!
Why are you getting excited? It's not a commission!
Ah, you must've come to Sumeru City for a visit.
I'm Yunus, a logistics officer of the Corps of Thirty in the Citadel of Regzar.
You look worried... Ran into some trouble?
Yes. Monsters in the wild have been restless for reasons unknown. We've had to send someone out to drive them away.
They move so fast in large numbers. People we sent to deal with them got whacked every time.
I was wondering what meals our cook should prepare for them.
Ah, it seems that another bunch of our men should be back now...
Now, if you'll excuse me. Have a good time in Sumeru City.
What a man of action...
Whew... I'm glad he didn't talk to me. I'm afraid of dealing with people from the Eremites...
Let me see... We'll head to Adventurers' Guild next.
Though I don't think it would be any different from the guilds of anywhere else...
But Julie may want to see it.
Ugh... Julie?
Huh? What was that?
We are going to visit the Adventurers' Guild. Are you coming?
Yeah! I've always wanted to visit there. L—Let's roll!
Do you need my help!?
Chill out! It's no serious business.
Is this the Adventurers' Guild?
Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild. Anything you're here for?
If you're looking to take commissions, just ask Katheryne over there.
You seem dispirited, Julie. Are you feeling exhausted?
Yeah, I'm a little tired.
We hardly got any rest after getting off the ship, and I'm exhausted too.
We should get something to eat soon and turn in, Parvaneh.
That sounds good. Shevirme's grill should still be open, so we ought to feast there.
Let's roll. I didn't expect Sumeru City to be so big that it wore me out just window shopping!
Finally, local Sumeru delicacies! Can't wait!
Parvaneh? You're back?
Are those your friends behind you?
Yes, they just got to Sumeru and I've been showing them around the city.
I saw you're open and wanted to get some Shawarma Wraps. Got enough ingredients for us?
Are you kidding me? Of course I do! Six rolls, one for each person, right? Give me a few minutes!
Wow, Paimon can't wait!
Shevirme starts to cook...
The smell, the taste... It's heavenly!
What an amazing flavor, completely different from Inazuma's cooking.
How is it, Julie?
Delicious, thanks...
Why are you so polite all of a sudden? Are you feeling okay?
So what's next?
We reserved lodging and will check in soon.
We'll leave Sumeru after Parvaneh's thesis gets officially passed.
Hold on.
After her thesis is accepted, she has to stay with the Akademiya to do research work, so she can't come with us anymore.
It's what she wants. She talked to us about it and we all understand.
That might be true, but it will feel like we're missing something.
So that's why Julie's seemed distracted the whole way...
That's probably the cause.
Even though everyone tried to avoid the subject, Parvaneh will likely remain with the Akademiya.
Come on, this is not the end of the world. It's not like we'll never see her again!
We can even bum a meal off the Akademiya when we come back later.
Parvaneh told us before that she kept in touch with her mentor, so she should get the result for her thesis in two or three days.
Yeah, come back to the Akademiya tomorrow and hang out with us.
Since we have no idea when the next time will be after we leave Sumeru.
Parvaneh's not leaving with you?
Shameless. She doesn't deserve the title of a researcher!
Plagiarizing and deceiving... That's what she learned at the Akademiya!?
How can Ms. Parvaneh get scolded by such scum!?
Chill, Mr. Kamei. This is the Akademiya. The Corps of Thirty is right down there.
Try anything rash and we'll all get busted!
Hmph... If we were back in Inazuma, I'd let my blade do the talking!
Why is everyone so angry? What's going on...
Traveler, you couldn't have come at... a worse time...
What's going on?
She's over there. I'll brief you on what happened.
Last night we went back to the inn with Parvaneh for a little chat.
Parvaneh was suddenly called away by a man from the Akademiya, who said something went wrong with her paper and she needed to discuss it with her mentor.
She was supposed to go alone. But we were a bit worried, so we went with her.
We heard outside that the researcher Farzah was talking to Parvaneh...
They started arguing, then Parvaneh came out, slammed the door, and bumped into us.
She explained to us that her paper might have been plagiarized by Farzah to... make some deals with someone.
We talked all night and couldn't come up with any good ideas, so today we came with her to talk to Farzah again.
Since Mr. Kamei got really angry, we're staying here, while Julie has gone with Parvaneh.
I could feel the tension in the air. Don't know how things are going over there...
I'll never cooperate with you. I've told you that!
Miss Parvaneh, I sincerely advise you to reconsider. This kind of win-win business is hard to come by.
Win-win? I'm not trying to win. I didn't write this paper to make money!
Hmph... This is not what we agreed on, Miss Farzah.
I'm not gonna lie to you. You can get your research out to the public faster by working with Mr. Nète.
Sounds like a liar...
Stay away from Parvaneh.
Or I won't be so polite.
Hmph... Miss Farzah, I presume something's wrong with the security of the Akademiya? Since when could an Adventurer come in here and give us cheek?
Julie, it's okay.
Ms. Farzah, I'll never trade "Omni-Spice" for even one Mora.
Since I wrote the first word of this paper, I've told you I'll provide the research results to anyone in need for free.
*sigh* Why won't you just listen...
See, I knew it would come to this.
That's all right, Miss Parvaneh. You can rest assured I won't make it difficult for you.
Even if you don't want to work with me... We'll find another way.
Farzah and Nète take their leave...
Parvaneh, are you alright?
This is bad...
Parvaneh!
Those two... They must've been planning this for a while.
My mentor... No, Farzah's had her eyes on my spice from the start. No wonder she was always so eager to discuss my paper with me...
Now she's developed a whole new project based on my paper, and made another seasoning to sell.
What do we do?
It's practically impossible for us to stop her from making an advanced "Omni-Spice"...
Looks like there's no other choice. We can only go with my dumb idea.
You already have an idea?
Of course not. It took us a whole night to figure it out.
Yes, I'm a chef... But I started out as a restaurant owner in Liyue Harbor, and I know a trick or two about running a business.
Parvaneh briefed me with some details, and I think I know how Farzah will make money off "Omni-Spice."
Those two misers will have to keep the spice formula to themselves if they want to make any money.
And my stupid way is the exact opposite of their plan, and that's...
To give the formula away to the public for free first.
If everyone had the formula for free, few would buy it when Nète tries to sell it.
But how do we give it to the people out there?
Hehe, guess what the Gourmet Supremos do best? We make meals with all ingredients and spices...
Are you saying you're going to spread the formula by making dishes with it?
But Parvaneh's paper...
It's okay...
It's just some dumb paper. No worries.
I had intended to give the "Omni-Spice" formula to everyone for free with my resources at the Akademiya anyway.
Nothing wrong with giving the formula away in the most straightforward way.
Parvaneh...
Ms. Parvaneh...
Parvaneh is indeed a true researcher at the Sumeru Akademiya. What an answer.
Then let's do what we planned last night!
Nète might have drummed up many to help him sell the formula. We must get ahead of him!
Julie, please ask the Adventurers' Guild for a list of villages that demand a lot of hard labor: fishing, lumbering or hunting. As long as it takes toil!
Leave it to me!
Mr. Kamei, please help us collect spices we are gonna need for cooking dishes.
I'll take care of that. Ms. Parvaneh has told me where to find Harra Fruit.
I know I can rely on you. Traveler, could you help Mr. Kamei find Harra Fruit for us?
Leave it to me.
We'll leave it in your hands, then.
Parvaneh and I will go back to the inn and figure out the menu. And when you're ready, we'll meet here.
Traveler, let me show you the rendezvous.
Let's roll. I didn't expect to have such fun in Sumeru City. This trip really is worth my time!
Save some meal for me.
No problem. I'll leave the most savory one for you!
But Parvaneh's research...
Is there any way we can stop her?
How can this be...
Where's Parvaneh?
Harra Fruit should be over there.
Let's split up and end this quickly.
Sure.
I just noticed there are traces of monsters around.
We could run into monsters if we keep going. Please be careful.
Please rendezvous with me once you have the Harra Fruit.
I'll be counting on you then.
Sorry, I haven't found any Harra Fruit... Anything on your end?
Great. These should be enough.
I need to gather some other ingredients nearby. Traveler, please go back and check on Ms. Julie.
Physical labor? If I must, I'll say Vimara Village, Caravan Ribat, and Port Ormos.
Vimara has farmers. Caravan Ribat and Port Ormos have a lot of menial laborers too.
But why do you want to know? Got a job to offer?
A good friend of mine asked me to look into this.
I see. Let me mark the locations on the map for you. They're all quite a way from the city, so try not to get lost.
Thank you!
How did it go?
Thanks to this mister's help, we got the locations.
The rendezvous is not far from here, Traveler. Let's hurry.
Thank you, Mr. Kamei, the ingredients should be enough. Parvaneh and I have decided on the menu.
We'll only need to wait for Julie to tell us where to make the meals.
We're back!
Great. Did you get any information?
We'd better go to Vimara Village and Caravan Ribat. They are marked on the map.
Sweet! We've got no time to waste. Let's visit Vimara Village first.
Field trip again...
Parvaneh? Why are you here? Didn't you go back to the Akademiya to submit your paper?
And why are there a bunch of people behind you? What is all this!?
Well, it's a long story...
Parvaneh tells Nabati what happened...
Food for marketing. That's new.
But how could Farzah do this? It doesn't make sense. There's no news of her project being suspended, and she is getting paid as usual.
Why are we doing business with a Fontaine guy...
Anyway, this is the situation. Come and help me! Think about the tons of homework you copied from me!
I didn't copy you! Don't forget, you referenced my outline!
Old acquaintances we've got here...
Hi there, I'm Nabati. I do research on the human body at Amurta.
Though my project hasn't been approved...
We went to the Akademiya together long ago, but we didn't really work together since we were studying different subjects.
Thank god we didn't. I could've choked on your weird dishes.
Don't stare at me like that. Let's get down to business.
You want to make dishes that appeal to the local taste in Vimara Village, right?
Any thoughts?
Vimara is located in a very convenient spot. It's a key area along the waterway to Sumeru. And if you go along the waterway, you will get to Port Ormos.
And most ships dock at Port Ormos.
Hard labors like loading cargo and repair work are mostly done at Port Ormos.
Over time, many people went to work there. Now only elders and kids stay at the village.
And slackers like me, of course.
Do you know what kind of food the folks like here?
Hmm... Light meals I guess. And fish is a regular dish here.
This place is so far away from the city that seasonings are hard to buy. Sometimes the dishes are incredibly bland.
The elders couldn't tell the difference, but I just couldn't stand it...
A peculiar guy from Fontaine did try to sell the spice you mentioned, but the residents here simply couldn't afford it...
Hehe, then it'd be great for you to try Parvaneh's "Omni-Spice."
Let's get back to business. Mr. Kamei, Julie, please help me set up the pot.
Mr. Nabati, I'm now introducing to you, the amazing "Omni-Spice."
Any dish with this "Omni-Spice" will have a delicious taste.
If you don't believe me, you can try the "Fish With Cream Sauce" made with this "Omni-Spice."
Traveler, please help us find some fresh fish and drop it off to Parvaneh. I'll have to go through the recipe a few more times...
Just checked this recipe five times. Whew... Hopefully we can make it right...
They don't seem to have any hard labors to do...
I must be crazy to actually do this... Ah! Traveler, did you get the ingredients?
Everything is ready... I've just checked the recipe twice more. Seven times in total. There won't be any problems.
Did you really remember that?
If there's a problem, I'll find a way out.
Alright, show's on!
Xudong starts cooking...
This is delicious! And it doesn't seem to have any special spices...
That's what makes the "Omni-Spice" so special! It brings out the flavor in the food, giving it an amazing taste.
More importantly, "Omni-Spice" is not difficult to make.
How much is this "Omni-Spice"? I'd like to buy some to try.
I'll give you the formula. Since you are a researcher, I'm sure you can make one on your own.
Wait, you're just giving it to me like that? This could sell for a lot of Mora! That Fontaine peddler put a high price on the spice.
And you're not happy about it? Take it, and be sure to share it with others. Don't just use it for your own food.
Okay. Parvaneh, you are crazy...
I think I am too. But it's good to be crazy once in a while.
Anyways, the formula is in your hands. Remember to share!
Since we can head to Port Ormos via the waterway, let's go there next.
You sure everything will be okay?
We're back to Port Ormos again.
So many people here. Where do we even start?
How about I beat someone in a duel and then recommend the spice to them?
Why do you have to beat someone in the first place...
Eh? Where did Xudong go?
Whoa...! So many port stevedores in Liyue!
Yeah. We got whacked every time we finish unloading.
Since when did he start chitchatting with that guy...?
One of Xudong's talents I guess...
*sigh* Life's so hard. Especially when you have to cook for yourself after getting off work. I feel exhausted just thinking about it.
Not for me. I have a special spice that can easily help me make delicious meals.
Well that was abrupt!
What... Are you here to peddle goods like the Fontaine guy? I don't have time for this.
I'd rather you just give me an offer like that Fontaine vendor did. And just to be clear, I don't have much in my pocket to handle some fancy spice.
Uh-oh! Busted!
Wait, our spice is nothing like what the Fontaine guy was selling to you.
We'll make a dish with the spice for you to try. For free.
That way you'll see how good this spice is.
This is too good to be true...
Chefs are generous. Traveler, please help us find two Potatoes and drop them off to Parvaneh.
Hmm... Let me think about making a "Potato Boat" for this mister.
Here he goes again... Traveler, did you get the ingredients?
That should do. Let me heat the pot up...
Xudong starts cooking...
Finished already? Where's the spicing?
Like I said, with this "Omni-Spice," any dish can become a delicious one.
This must cost a pile of Mora. The Fontaine peddler put a high price on his spice, too...
Here, this is the formula of "Omni-Spice." It's easy to prepare. You can make some back at home.
Wh—What do you mean? You don't want my Mora?
We want nothing from you. Instead, we kindly ask you to share this formula to the public.
Well, you got it for free. It'd be nice to give it to others as a free favor, wouldn't it?
That makes sense... Thanks.
Xudong's got quite a way with words. Paimon didn't see that before...
That's one of the skills a chef must master. You can't take care of customers of all kinds without a silver tongue, can you?
It's so hard to be a chef at Liyue Harbor!
Okay. Our final stop would be "Caravan Ribat."
Parvaneh said she knows Maryam, owner of Gilded Journey. And she told her about our spice marketing.
Let's hope it goes well this time, too.
You're finally back. I thought you'd give up halfway through.
I heard it from Parvaneh. You tried to give the spice away for free in response to that Fontaine guy?
What a stupid idea for an Akademiya researcher.
Ahem...
Sorry, the idea came from me. I'm a chef.
Hmm... Since I know Parvaneh, I can help you promote this "Omni-Spice."
You must have been tired after all the work.
Hey chef, the ingredients are all ready in the kitchen, and there's a fire and a pot outside. You can cook something anytime.
And take a good rest when you're done. The lady researcher must be tired even if you are not.
I dare not refuse it.
Traveler, could you please help me gather some Padisarahs? It's certainly been a long day for everyone, and I wanna prepare a fine meal to treat everybody.
Leave it to me.
I'll prepare the rest of the ingredients. When you get the Padisarahs, please give them to Parvaneh. Thank you, Traveler.
How are you holding up?
No worries. It was way more exhausting back when I was making banquets back in Liyue.
It's great Miss Maryam is willing to help... Traveler, did you get the Padisarahs?
That should be enough. I'll take care of it. It won't be long.
Xudong starts cooking...
Ah, that smells good! What did you make?
This is "Tandoori Roast Chicken." It sounds weird, but does have a good taste.
When did you learn to cook this? I've never seen you do that before.
Flicked through the recipe yesterday. It's in my mind now.
You are such an exceptional chef, Mr. Xudong...
I might have been able to speed up my research if I'd known you sooner...
That Nète guy... seems to be exactly where we're going, and he's always one step ahead of us.
He didn't seem to be able to sell any spice... But why has he been keeping pace with us?
I don't have a good feeling about that Nète guy...
I guess you're well rested. Take this letter. That Nète guy from Fontaine asked me to give it to you.
He's here?
The guy's left. He paid me to prepare the ingredients and wait for you to come.
He told me to give you the letter after you have rested.
Sorry for not telling you this. But he paid a lot.
Parvaneh, what does it say?
...Bunch of sentimental crap. He said he has business to talk about with us at the Akademiya.
Hmph, I guess that scum's had enough and is appealing to arms?
It would actually be better if that was the case...
Well, if Nète said so. We're so going there for a meet-up.
Traveler, could you come with us for another trip?
Sure.
Hehe, I'll be looking forward to it, then.
Then let's get going. Time to see what this guy wants.
I'll teach him a lesson.
When did he give it to you?
Welcome! Welcome, everyone. I've been waiting for you.
What are you up to? Stay away!
Easy, Miss Adventurer. I don't wish to fight you, nor do I have the ability to.
Your plan has worked. Your free spice is taking over the market. It'll be even harder for me to promote a new spice.
You've won this one. Please go easy on this poor businessman.
You're lying through your teeth... I have never met a man more loathsome than you.
Hahaha! It seems like you haven't dealt with many businessmen, then.
You are not with Farzah?
She might be working on her new formula. Locked herself in her room and won't come out... But to be honest, I don't really care about this.

You know, I did tons of work just to skirt around some boring clauses... And she wouldn't even get down from her high horse as a researcher. I also had to find resources to promote her spice because she refused to do it herself.
I was wrong. She's not the right pick for a business partner.
But now I think you're perfect for business.
You have plans and are willing to get your hands dirty. Plus, you have pretty decent skills.
Are you here to cause trouble?
Relax, I just want to ask... Are there any opportunities for me to invest in you?
What?
Do you know what you're talking about?
You are so unpredictable.
Hmph. Liar.
Are you serious?
Of course I am. What makes you think I'm not?
Your spice formula is taking root on the market, enjoying popularity and reputation among consumers.
The formula Ms. Farzah is making will be of higher quality, but it's somewhat difficult to promote.
And I know you are not willing to cooperate with her.
So here's my offer: I'll invest in your spice and organize resources for the business.
Part of the profits I made from Ms. Farzah's formula will be used to promote your formula for free, and the rest of the profits... will be all yours.
You don't have to pay a single Mora. You just need to put my "trademark" on the back of your formula.
What do you say?
I say no. I've told you before. I don't want anything to do with you.
And why would you even want to invest in our formula? Ms. Farzah is a more experienced researcher who has way more resources than me.
Experiences, resources... Those can be improved in many ways.
But you cannot build your word of mouth like that overnight, hehe...
Huh, I think I've said too much. Well, I guess that's it for today. I have to go back and see if Ms. Farzah is starving in her lab.
I will stay in Sumeru for some time. I sincerely look forward to working with you one day. So long.
Nète leaves...
I'm so sick of him...
He could be more tricky than monsters...
Farzah, Nète... I guess the whole thing is not as simple as we had hoped for.
Looks like we won't be able to leave Sumeru for now. We must look into this.
*sigh* I just wanted to do my research. Why did I get into this mess...
Haha, it is what it is. A restaurant must be cleaned before it can be opened to customers.
Don't worry. We'll get to the bottom of this.
Traveler, looks like we're gonna team up again. We might still need your help in the future.
Sure.
That's the spirit!
But... What is this Nète plotting...?
As long as there's free meals.
What are you trying to do?
You really have no business sense. Good thing you've met me...
I didn't expect all this to happen in Sumeru. This is fun...
Parvaneh, are you alright?
It's pretty tranquil here.
Omni-Spice? What's that supposed to be?
That Fontaine guy's name must be Nète.
Why is Xudong chatting with everyone...?
I feel humbled before one with such affinity...
How come a man sells spice like this?
Wow, that looks like a nice pot.
Wow, she looks like such a proper lady...
A mysterious lady...
Why don't you rest up over here?
